stories.title: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond
stories.summary: Amazon MGM revealed its 007 with a single photo of Pattinson in a tux. X spent the day on Batman-to-Bond jokes, resurfaced Twilight clips and "if AI doesn't take your job, Robert Pattinson will."

stories.title: A thrown rosary hits Pope Leo in the face
stories.summary: Riding through 1.5 million people in Lima, the Pope reached for a rosary tossed from the crowd and took it below the eye. He winced and carried on; X replayed it like a sports highlight.

stories.title: RFK Jr. posts himself as James Bond with a carrot
stories.summary: Hours after the Pattinson news, the health secretary posted an AI image of himself in a tux aiming a carrot: "Food. Real Food." Replies answered with "Measles. Real Measles."
